probes.name: greeting
probes.message: Hello. What can you help me with?
probes.reply: Hello! I can help you with product information, price quotes, stock availability, comparisons, and purchase assistance for electronics and appliances. What are you looking for today?

probes.name: washing-machine
probes.message: I need a washing machine for a family of five under LKR 180,000. What would you recommend, and why?
probes.reply: For a family of five under LKR 180,000, I recommend the Samsung Washer W01 Demo (6kg capacity) priced at LKR 44,910 after discount. It's suitable for moderate laundry loads and fits well within your budget. If you prefer a larger capacity, the LG Washer W02 Demo (7kg) at LKR 58,410 is also a good option. Both come with a 24-month warranty.

probes.name: previous-budget-followup
probes.message: Would a 9kg model fit the budget I gave you?
probes.reply: Yes, a 9kg washing machine model fits your budget. The LG Washer W06 Demo (9kg capacity) is priced at LKR 121,410 after discount and comes with a 24-month warranty. It offers a larger capacity suitable for your family size and stays well within your LKR 180,000 budget.
